name: Moduix
summary: Accessible React, Solid and Vue components on Ark UI, installed as npm packages or copied through a shadcn registry.
description: Multi-framework component system with matching CSS Modules and Tailwind styling tracks and shared design tokens. Covers form fields, overlays, navigation and data display components, plus 12 ready-made blocks such as app header, sidebar dashboard, auth screens and data table, installable with one shadcn command.
contains: React, Solid and Vue components built on Ark UI; Svelte is planned
59 documentation pages covering components, utilities, forms and styling guides
install as npm packages or copy owned source with the shadcn registry
CSS Modules and Tailwind styling tracks with shared design tokens
12 ready-made blocks: app header, sidebar dashboard, auth screens, data table, gallery
AI guide, llms.txt and an installable moduix agent skill
